task: A colleague greets you on Monday morning. You feel good today. Answer, add one detail, and ask back.
say: Morning! How are you?
zh: 周一早上同事跟你打招呼。你今天状态不错。回答，加一个细节，再反问对方。对方说：早！你好吗？
example: Morning! Pretty good, thanks. I actually slept well for once. How about you?

task: The barista at your local café asks about your day. Answer, add one detail, and ask back.
say: Hi there! How's your day going?
zh: 常去的咖啡店的咖啡师问你今天过得怎样。回答，加一个细节，再反问对方。对方说：你好！今天过得怎么样？
example: Not bad, thanks! It's only just started, so this coffee's very welcome. Has it been busy this morning?

task: Your neighbour says hi over the fence. You're a bit tired today. Answer honestly but lightly, and ask back.
say: Hey, how's it going?
zh: 邻居隔着篱笆跟你打招呼。你今天有点累。诚实但轻松地回答，再反问对方。对方说：嘿，最近怎么样？
example: Yeah, not bad, just a bit tired. I stayed up way too late watching a movie. How are you going?

task: You run into a friend you haven't seen for months. You've been busy with work. Answer briefly and turn the question back.
say: Hey! Long time no see. How've you been?
zh: 你碰到几个月没见的朋友。你最近工作很忙。简短回答，再把问题抛回给对方。对方说：嘿！好久不见。最近怎么样？
example: Hey! Yeah, good thanks, just flat out with work. But what about you? What have you been up to?

task: It's Friday afternoon. A colleague asks about your weekend plans. You might go to the beach. Answer and ask back.
say: Any plans for the weekend?
zh: 周五下午，同事问你周末的计划。你可能会去海边。回答并反问对方。对方说：周末有什么安排吗？
example: Might head to the beach if the weather holds. Nothing too exciting. What about you, got anything planned?

task: The security guard at reception asks you a quick question as you walk past. You've had meetings all morning. Answer with one detail.
say: Busy day today?
zh: 你经过前台时，保安随口问你一句。你一上午都在开会。回答并加一个细节。对方说：今天很忙吗？
example: Yeah, meetings all morning. I'm finally escaping for some lunch. Hope it's a bit quieter down here!

task: On Monday a colleague asks about your weekend. You went to a friend's barbecue. Answer, add a detail, and ask back.
say: How was your weekend?
zh: 周一同事问你周末过得怎样。你去参加了朋友的烧烤聚会。回答，加个细节，再反问对方。对方说：周末过得怎么样？
example: Really good, thanks. We went to a mate's barbecue on Saturday and the weather was perfect. How was yours?

task: A colleague asks about your weekend. It was quiet: washing and grocery shopping. Answer honestly and ask back.
say: Did you get up to much on the weekend?
zh: 同事问你周末做了什么。你的周末很平淡：洗衣服、买菜。如实回答，再反问对方。对方说：周末有做什么吗？
example: Not really, just washing and groceries. Pretty quiet, but sometimes that's what you need. Did you do anything fun?

task: Your manager asks how work is going. You're busy, but you're enjoying the new project. Answer with one detail.
say: So how's work going for you at the moment?
zh: 经理问你最近工作怎么样。你很忙，但很喜欢新项目。回答并加一个细节。对方说：你最近工作怎么样？
example: Busy, but in a good way. I'm really enjoying the new project, and I'm learning heaps about the payment system.

task: You're back at work after a week off. You took your family to Rotorua. Answer, add a detail, and ask back.
say: Welcome back! Did you have a good break?
zh: 你休了一周假后回来上班。你带家人去了罗托鲁瓦。回答，加个细节，再反问对方。对方说：欢迎回来！假期过得好吗？
example: Yeah, it was great, thanks. We took the family to Rotorua and everyone loved the mud pools. Did you manage to get any time off?

task: An older neighbour asks about your family. Everyone is well and your daughter just started school. Answer with a detail and ask back.
say: And how's the family?
zh: 一位年长的邻居问起你的家人。大家都好，你女儿刚开始上学。回答，加个细节，再反问对方。对方说：家里人都好吗？
example: All good, thanks. Our daughter just started school, and she loves it so far. How are your grandkids doing?

task: A friend asks what you did last night. You made dumplings with some friends. Answer with a detail and ask back.
say: What did you get up to last night?
zh: 朋友问你昨晚做了什么。你和几个朋友一起包了饺子。回答，加个细节，再反问对方。对方说：你昨晚干嘛了？
example: We had a few friends over and made dumplings. We made way too many, so I've got lunch sorted all week. What about you?

task: A colleague notices you look tired. Your toddler woke up at 3 a.m. Answer and keep it light.
say: You look tired. Late night?
zh: 同事发现你看起来很累。你家小孩凌晨三点就醒了。回答，语气轻松一点。对方说：你看起来好累。昨晚熬夜了？
example: Sort of! Our little one was up at three and wouldn't go back to sleep. The coffee's helping, though.

task: A colleague asks about your weekend. Your son was sick, so you stayed home. Answer with a detail and ask back.
say: Hey, good weekend?
zh: 同事问你周末过得好不好。你儿子生病了，所以你们一直在家。回答，加个细节，再反问对方。对方说：嘿，周末过得好吗？
example: Not the best, to be honest. My son had a tummy bug, so we were stuck at home. He's back at school today, though. How was yours?

task: You asked a colleague about their weekend. Show interest with a follow-up question.
say: Pretty good. We finally tried that new Korean place in town.
zh: 你问了同事周末过得怎样。用一个追问表示你感兴趣。对方说：挺好的。我们终于去试了城里那家新开的韩国餐厅。
example: Oh nice, I've walked past that place heaps of times. Was it any good? What did you order?

task: You joined this team two weeks ago. Your manager asks how it's going. Answer with a detail and a little humour.
say: How are you settling in?
zh: 你两周前加入这个团队。经理问你适应得怎么样。回答，加个细节，再带一点幽默。对方说：适应得怎么样了？
example: Really well, thanks. Everyone's been super helpful, and I'm getting my head around the code. I still get lost looking for the meeting rooms, though!

task: A friend asks about your move. You're moving this weekend and there are boxes everywhere. Answer with a detail.
say: How's the move going?
zh: 朋友问你搬家的进展。你这周末搬家，家里到处都是箱子。回答并加一个细节。对方说：搬家进行得怎么样？
example: Ugh, chaos! There are boxes everywhere and I can't find anything. I've been eating off paper plates all week. Can't wait for it to be over.

task: It's Friday. A colleague asks about your week. It was long, but the release went out on Thursday. Answer and ask back.
say: Had a good week?
zh: 今天周五。同事问你这周过得怎样。这周很漫长，但版本周四顺利发布了。回答并反问对方。对方说：这周过得好吗？
example: Long, but good. We finally got the release out on Thursday, so I'm feeling pretty relieved. How was yours?

task: Your neighbour shares some good news. React with happiness and ask a follow-up question.
say: Guess what? Our daughter got into uni in Dunedin.
zh: 邻居跟你分享好消息。表达开心，并追问一个问题。对方说：你猜怎么着？我们女儿考上了但尼丁的大学。
example: Oh, that's fantastic news! You must be so proud. What's she going to study?

task: You asked a colleague how they are. React with sympathy and ask a gentle question.
say: Not great, actually. My cat's been really sick.
zh: 你问同事最近好吗。表达同情，并温和地问一个问题。对方说：不太好。我的猫病得挺重的。
example: Oh no, I'm sorry to hear that. That's really stressful. Is she getting any better?

task: A friend says you look well. You've started running in the mornings. Accept the compliment, give a detail, and ask back.
say: You're looking well! What's your secret?
zh: 朋友说你气色很好。你最近开始晨跑了。接受称赞，加个细节，再反问对方。对方说：你气色真好！有什么秘诀？
example: Oh, thanks! I've started running in the mornings, just three times a week. I hated it at first, but now I actually like it. Do you do much exercise?

task: A colleague asks about your new house. You love it, but the garden is a lot of work. Answer with a detail and ask a related question.
say: So how's the new house?
zh: 同事问你新房子怎么样。你很喜欢，但花园太费功夫。回答，加个细节，再问一个相关的问题。对方说：新房子怎么样？
example: We love it. The only thing is the garden. It's huge, and I've never mowed a lawn in my life! You're into gardening, aren't you? Any tips?

task: A colleague asks about last night's rugby game. You didn't watch it. Be honest and show interest with a question.
say: Did you catch the game last night?
zh: 同事问你昨晚有没有看橄榄球比赛。你没看。如实回答，再用一个问题表示感兴趣。对方说：你昨晚看比赛了吗？
example: No, I missed it. I saw the score this morning, though. Sounded really close! Was it a good game?

task: A colleague asks how you are. You're stressed about a deadline. Answer honestly but keep it light, then ask back.
say: How are you doing?
zh: 同事问你最近怎么样。你因为截止日期压力很大。诚实回答但保持轻松，再反问对方。对方说：你最近怎么样？
example: Honestly? A bit stressed. We've got a big deadline on Friday. But I'll survive, ask me again next week! How are things with you?

task: Your manager asks about your long weekend. You walked the Tongariro Crossing. Share one highlight and ask back.
say: Do anything fun over the long weekend?
zh: 经理问你长周末做了什么。你去走了汤加里罗高山徒步。分享一个亮点，再反问对方。对方说：长周末做了什么好玩的吗？
example: Yeah, I did the Tongariro Crossing. My legs are still sore, but the view from the top was amazing. Have you ever done it?

task: A friend asks about your mum, who was visiting from China. She flew home last week. Answer with a detail.
say: How's your mum? Is she still here?
zh: 朋友问起从中国来探亲的妈妈。她上周已经飞回去了。回答并加一个细节。对方说：你妈妈怎么样？她还在这儿吗？
example: She flew back last week, actually. The house feels so quiet now. She loved the beaches, though, so she's already planning to come back next summer.

task: A colleague asks what you did on Saturday. You tried golf at a driving range for the first time. Answer with a detail and ask back.
say: What did you get up to on Saturday?
zh: 同事问你周六做了什么。你第一次去高尔夫练习场打球。回答，加个细节，再反问对方。对方说：你周六干嘛了？
example: I tried golf for the first time, just at the driving range. I missed the ball more than I hit it! Do you play at all?

task: A colleague gave you a very short answer about their weekend. Keep the conversation going with a light follow-up question.
say: Oh, not much. Just relaxed at home.
zh: 同事关于周末的回答很简短。用一个轻松的追问让对话继续。对方说：哦，没做什么。就在家休息。
example: Sometimes that's the best kind of weekend. Did you watch anything good? I'm looking for a new show.

task: A colleague says the week is going slowly. Agree lightly and add your own comment.
say: This week's really dragging, eh?
zh: 同事说这周过得好慢。轻松地表示同意，再加一句你自己的看法。对方说：这周过得真慢，是吧？
example: Tell me about it. I checked my calendar this morning and couldn't believe it was only Wednesday. At least it's meant to be sunny on the weekend.

task: You meet a former colleague at the supermarket. You changed jobs three months ago. Answer with a detail and ask back.
say: Hey! Are you still at the same place?
zh: 你在超市遇到以前的同事。你三个月前换了工作。回答，加个细节，再反问对方。对方说：嘿！你还在原来那家公司吗？
example: No, I moved on about three months ago. I'm at a smaller company in Newmarket now, and I'm really enjoying it. Are you still with the old team?

task: A colleague asks about your weekend. You tried baking bread and it went badly. Tell it as a short funny story and ask back.
say: How was your weekend? Anything fun?
zh: 同事问你周末过得怎样。你试着烤面包，结果很失败。把它讲成一个好笑的小故事，再反问对方。对方说：周末过得怎么样？有什么好玩的吗？
example: I tried baking bread for the first time. It came out as hard as a rock. We ended up using it as a doorstop! Do you bake at all?

task: A colleague asks if you had a busy weekend. It was full of kids' sport and parties. Give a short, funny description and ask back.
say: Busy weekend?
zh: 同事问你周末是不是很忙。周末全是孩子的运动和派对。用简短好笑的描述回答，再反问对方。对方说：周末很忙吗？
example: Crazy busy! Netball at eight, a birthday party at eleven and swimming at three. I think I need a weekend to recover from my weekend. Was yours any calmer?

task: You were off sick with the flu last week. A colleague asks if you're better. Thank them, give a detail, and add a little humour.
say: Oh, you're back! Feeling better?
zh: 你上周得流感请了病假。同事问你好些了没。谢谢对方，加个细节，再带点幽默。对方说：哦，你回来啦！好点了吗？
example: Much better, thanks. I spent four days on the couch and watched a whole season of a show I don't even like. Did I miss anything exciting?

task: A colleague says the weekend went too fast. Yours actually felt long and relaxing. Disagree politely and explain.
say: Weekend went way too fast, eh?
zh: 同事说周末过得太快了。你的周末其实感觉很长、很放松。礼貌地表示不同意并解释。对方说：周末过得太快了，是吧？
example: Funny, mine actually felt really long, in a good way. We didn't plan anything, so it felt like a mini holiday. Did you have a lot on?

task: A colleague asks about your holiday. You went back to China to see family for the first time in three years. Share a short story and ask back.
say: Did you have a good break? Go anywhere nice?
zh: 同事问你假期过得怎样。你三年来第一次回中国看家人。分享一个小故事，再反问对方。对方说：假期过得好吗？去了什么好地方吗？
example: I went back to China to see my family, first time in three years! My nephew was a baby last time, and now he beats me at chess. How was your break?

task: A colleague asks if anything exciting happened. Your weekend was really boring. Make it funny, then turn the question back.
say: So, anything exciting happen on the weekend?
zh: 同事问你周末有没有什么精彩的事。你的周末其实很无聊。把它说得好笑一点，再把问题抛回去。对方说：周末有什么精彩的事吗？
example: Honestly, the highlight was getting a park right outside the supermarket. That's how exciting my life is. Please tell me yours was better!

task: A colleague asks about your house hunting. It's going badly and you'd rather not talk about it. Answer briefly, then smoothly change the topic.
say: How's the house hunting going?
zh: 同事问你看房进展如何。进展不顺，你不太想多谈。简短回答，然后自然地换个话题。对方说：找房子找得怎么样了？
example: Slowly! We've seen about twenty places and loved none of them. Anyway, enough about that. How was your trip to Wellington?

task: A neighbour asks how much you paid for your new car. You don't want to say. Deflect politely with humour and move the conversation on.
say: Nice new car! What did that set you back?
zh: 邻居问你新车花了多少钱。你不想说。用幽默礼貌地岔开，再把话题引开。对方说：新车不错啊！花了多少钱？
example: Ha, more than I wanted to spend! But it's so much cheaper to run than the old one. Are you thinking of changing yours?

task: At a barbecue, a friend who runs a café asks about your IT job. You spent the week fixing a bug. Explain it simply, with a bit of humour, and ask back.
say: How's work? Still fixing computers?
zh: 在烧烤聚会上，一位开咖啡馆的朋友问你的 IT 工作。你这周一直在修一个 bug。简单地解释，带点幽默，再反问对方。对方说：工作怎么样？还在修电脑吗？
example: Ha, sort of! I spent the whole week looking for one tiny mistake in the code. Found it on Friday afternoon and felt like a hero. How's the café going?

task: A colleague asks about your holiday in Napier. It rained almost every day, but you still had fun. Tell a short story with a positive twist and ask back.
say: How was Napier? Did you get some sun?
zh: 同事问你去内皮尔度假怎么样。几乎天天下雨，但你们还是玩得很开心。讲一个带积极转折的小故事，再反问对方。对方说：内皮尔怎么样？晒到太阳了吗？
example: Not one bit! It rained five days out of seven. But we found a great little cinema and an amazing bakery, so we still had fun. Have you been?
